title: Jola-Fonyi language
description: Jola language spoken in West Africa
extract: Jola, also called Jola-Fonyi and Kujamataak, is a language spoken by 475,000 people in the Casamance region of Senegal, and neighboring countries. Jola-Fonyi is one of several closely related Jola languages spoken in the area.
